thehonestguy.bio: Toronto R&B singer-songwriter THEHONESTGUY, born Mubarak Adeyemi, is a Nigerian-Canadian artist whose warm, groove-led soul blends classic R&B, gospel, jazz and Nigerian musical influence.

thisisscribe.bio: Scarborough-born poet and rapper Joshua 'Scribe' Watkis is a Canadian hip-hop and spoken-word artist, educator and national poetry champion whose work centers storytelling and community engagement.

uncle fester.bio: Nova Scotia DJ and producer Uncle Fester is a veteran of Canadian hip-hop whose work spans beatmaking, engineering, touring, the Backburner collective and production for artists across the East Coast underground scene.

édouard tremblay-grenier.bio: Québec musician, singer-songwriter and actor Édouard Tremblay-Grenier makes French-language alternative pop and rock rooted in the province's contemporary songwriting tradition.
